problem_name: p04012 AtCoder Beginner Contest 044 - Beautiful Strings

solution_code:
n=int(input())
l=list(map(int,input().split()))
l.sort()
x=0
for i in range(n-1):
    x+=l[i+1]-l[i]-1
print(x)

problem_name: p02899 AtCoder Beginner Contest 142 - Go to School
solution_code:
N = int(input())
A = [int(i) for i in input().split()]
B=[0]*N
for i in range(N):
  B[A[i]-1]=i+1
print(*B)
